firstPlayerRule: The player whose birthday is closest to the next equinox goes first.
clarifications: The rulebook describes the spring equinox as on or around March 21 and the autumn equinox as on or around September 23 in the Northern Hemisphere.
Rounds proceed clockwise, starting with the first player.
internalEvidence: Visually checked Next Move English rulebook PDF page 1; text on PDF page 2 confirms clockwise round order. Setup step 6 selects the birthday closest to the next equinox.
